item.title: Chef Jonathan Zaragoza for Vitamix
item.description: Filmed and edited by Michael Thomas for Vitamix. Jonathan Zaragoza’s restaurant only serves one thing: the most incredible birria you’ve ever experienced. But behind the laser-like focus of his family restaurant, Zaragoza is a surprisingly inventive chef with Michelin-level plating skills.

item.title: Testing Autotrack on the Phantom 4 Pro
item.description: One of the most surprising things about DJI’s updated Autotrack feature is that it doesn’t just follow a moving subject at a set distance.
